name: Extreme Water Sports
summary: A Barbados watersports team with jet skis, towed inflatables, water skiing, wakeboarding and kayaks, plus private boat trips priced by the hour. Snorkel trips go out to swim with turtles and see a shipwreck, and leisure cruises follow the coast with drinks on board. Longer outings of 1, 2, 4 or 8 hours can be set up, including trips for cruise ship passengers.
standouts: Jet skis and boats available 7 days a week, 365 days a year
Outings of 1, 2, 4 or 8 hours, from Bridgetown to Speightstown
Snorkel trips on twin engine and single engine boats
Works with local hotels, restaurants and private villas

offers.text: Custom plans: combined activities, group bookings and special events, arranged by WhatsApp

checkNotes: Booking route: every Book Now button goes to https://www.doitonwater.com/book-now, a Wix Bookings widget that loads by script, so its contents could not be read. The site's own booking-services sitemap and its /about page list only two Wix template services ('Operational Consulting' and 'Project Management', 1 hr), so the widget may not actually sell these activities; check it in a browser. WhatsApp (+1 246 245 2029 and +1 246 822 7010) is the other route. Location: the site names no town or address; the footer Google Maps link points to 'The Beach Shack' (pin 13.2496, -59.6437), and the batch list gives St Peter, so town and departsFrom are left null. The email funonwater246@gmail.com comes from the site's Wix business settings in the page source, not from visible text. Prices are shown in USD on the activities page, while the Wix booking settings list the payment currency as BBD. Several activity photos (file names starting 7469db_) and gallery photos (8ff218_) were uploaded under a different Wix account than the site owner's files and some are small (under 300 px), so they may not be the operator's own photos. The site was last updated 25 July 2025 per its sitemap.
